scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../mobile-app && npm install
scripts.predev:pc: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('neutralino.config.json')); c.url='http://localhost:5173'; fs.writeFileSync('neutralino.config.json', JSON.stringify(c, null, 2));"
scripts.dev: npm run build:frontend && concurrently "npm run watch:frontend" "npm run start:neu" "npm run start:mobile"
scripts.prebuild:pc: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('neutralino.config.json')); c.url='/'; fs.writeFileSync('neutralino.config.json', JSON.stringify(c, null, 2));"
